# sqlpipe v2.0

sqlpipe v2.0 includes one breaking API change, one new CLI flag, and faster Parquet writes.

## Breaking changes

WARNING: Update all clients that call `/v2/users`. The API no longer returns the `name` field on user records. Each record has `first_name` and `last_name` instead. Update your parsers, SQL mappings, and downstream jobs before you deploy v2.0. Clients that read `name` will get incomplete data.

## New features

The `--incremental` flag is available on sync commands. With this flag, sqlpipe syncs only rows that are new or changed since the last run. You do not need a full sync on every run.

## Performance

Parquet writes are 40% faster than in v1.x. Large exports complete in less time. You do not need to change your configuration to get this speed.
